title: Set 250

sentences.ko: 분위기 깨고 싶진 않은데, 내일 비행기가 진짜 이른 시간이라 이 잔만 마시고 먼저 일어나야 할 것 같아.
sentences.text: I hate to be that person, but I've got a really early flight tomorrow, so I think I'm going to head out after this drink.

alts.text: Sorry to bail, but I've got a super early flight tomorrow, so I'm gonna take off after this drink.
I apologize for leaving early, but I have a very early flight tomorrow, so I believe I will be leaving after this drink.

sentences.note: **I hate to be that person** 은 분위기 깨는 말을 꺼낼 때 미안한 마음을 담아 쓰는 말이에요. **head out** 은 자리를 뜨다, 가 보다 라는 뜻이고, 캐주얼에 나오는 **bail** 도 먼저 빠지다 라는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 저녁 모임에서 먼저 일어날 구실 만들기

sentences.ko: 저기요, 부엌 싱크대에서 또 물이 새요. 일단 밑에 양동이를 받쳐 놨는데 물이 수납장 안까지 스며들기 시작해서요. 더 심해지기 전에 이번 주 안에 사람 좀 보내 주실 수 있을까요?
sentences.text: Hey, so the kitchen sink's leaking again. I put a bucket under it for now, but the water's starting to get into the cabinet, so could you send someone this week before it gets any worse?

alts.text: Ugh, the kitchen sink's leaking again. There's a bucket under it for now, but water's getting into the cabinet, so can you get someone over this week before it gets worse?

Hello, I wanted to let you know that the kitchen sink is leaking again. I have placed a bucket under it for the time being, but the water is beginning to seep into the cabinet. Could you please send someone this week before it gets any worse?

sentences.note: **for now** 는 일단, 당분간 이라는 뜻이에요. **before it gets any worse** 는 더 나빠지기 전에 라는 말로, 빨리 처리해 달라고 할 때 잘 써요.
sentences.situation: 집주인이랑 고장 난 것 고쳐 달라고 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 우리 고양이가 요즘 새벽 4시에 나를 깨우기 시작했어. 침대 옆 협탁에 있는 물건을 떨어뜨리면 내가 일어나서 밥을 준다는 걸 알아낸 거야. 근데 나는 매번 넘어가 주니까 뭐 내 탓도 좀 있는 것 같아.
sentences.text: My cat's started waking me up at four in the morning, because she figured out that if she knocks stuff off my nightstand, I'll get up and feed her. And I keep falling for it, so I guess that's kind of on me.

alts.text: So my cat's been getting me up at four a.m. now. She figured out if she knocks stuff off my nightstand, I'll get up and feed her. And I fall for it every time, so yeah, that's kinda my fault.

My cat has started waking me at four in the morning, because she has learned that if she knocks items off my nightstand, I will get up and feed her. I continue to give in, so I suppose that is partly my own responsibility.

sentences.note: **fall for it** 은 속아 넘어가다 라는 뜻이에요. **that's on me** 는 그건 내 책임이다, 내 탓이다 라는 말이고, 여기서는 kind of 를 붙여 좀 내 탓이다 라고 누그러뜨렸어요.

sentences.ko: 자전거 타는 데는 문제없는데, 미리 말씀드리면 뒷브레이크가 좀 약해요. 한번 점검받아 보시는 게 좋을 거예요. 그래서 80달러만 받는 거예요.
sentences.text: The bike rides fine, but I should tell you the back brake's a little weak, so you'll probably want to get it looked at. That's why I'm only asking eighty bucks for it.

alts.text: Rides fine, but heads up, the back brake's kinda weak, so you'll wanna get it checked. That's why I'm only asking eighty bucks.
The bicycle rides well, but I should mention that the rear brake is somewhat weak, so you will likely want to have it inspected. That is why I am asking only eighty dollars for it.

sentences.note: **get it looked at** 은 맡겨서 점검받다 라는 뜻이에요. **bucks** 는 달러를 편하게 부르는 말이고, 캐주얼의 **heads up** 은 미리 알려 줄 게 있을 때 쓰는 말이에요.
sentences.situation: 중고로 물건 팔면서 상태 솔직히 말하기

sentences.ko: 회사가 싫다거나 그런 건 아닌데, 6년이나 다녔더니 이제 딱히 배우는 게 없어. 지금 안 나가면 10년 뒤에도 똑같은 일 하고 있을 것 같다는 생각이 자꾸 들어.
sentences.text: I don't hate my job or anything, but I've been there six years and I'm not really learning anything anymore. I keep thinking if I don't leave now, I'm going to wake up in ten years still doing the exact same thing.

alts.text: It's not like I hate my job, but it's been six years and I'm not really learning anything now. I keep thinking if I don't get out now, I'm gonna wake up in ten years doing the exact same stuff.

I do not dislike my job, but I have been there for six years and I am no longer learning anything new. I often think that if I do not leave now, I will find myself ten years from now still doing exactly the same work.

sentences.note: **or anything** 은 문장 끝에 붙여 뭐 그런 건 아니고 처럼 말을 부드럽게 해요. **I keep thinking** 은 자꾸 그런 생각이 든다 라는 뜻이에요.

reviewed: 3번 한국어: started waking me up 의 '요즘 ~하기 시작했다' 뜻이 빠져 있어 '깨우기 시작했어'로 고침
4번 한국어: '그래서'가 두 번 이어져 어색해서 앞의 것을 뺌
4번 casual: prob 는 문자에서 쓰는 줄임말이라 소리내어 말하면 어색해서 뺌. It rides great 는 text 의 fine 보다 과장이라 Rides fine 으로 맞춤
2번 formal: becomes any worse 는 어색해서 gets any worse 로 고침
5번 formal: no longer learning very much 는 원문(거의 배우는 게 없다)보다 눅여서 no longer learning anything new 로 고침
